title: HR Manager
description:
**Job Description – HR Manager**

**Position:** HR Manager  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Organization:** Goenka Hospital  
**Location:** Piplaj, Pethapur, Gandhinagar, Gujarat  
**Reporting To:** Management / Hospital Administrator / Director  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Position Purpose**

The HR Manager will be responsible for managing the complete Human Resources function of the hospital, ensuring effective manpower planning, recruitment, employee engagement, performance management, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, training, employee relations, and implementation of HR policies and systems.

The role requires close coordination with **Doctors, Nursing Staff, Medical Officers, Paramedical Staff, Technicians, Front Office, Administration, Housekeeping, Security, Pharmacy, Accounts and other hospital departments**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Manpower Planning \& Workforce Management**

* Prepare department\-wise manpower requirements in coordination with HODs.
* Maintain approved manpower budgets and staffing plans.
* Monitor vacancies, employee strength, absenteeism and turnover.
* Ensure adequate staffing across critical hospital functions and shifts.
* Maintain updated organization structure and employee master data.

**2\. Recruitment \& Selection**

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for doctors, nurses, technicians, administrative and support staff.
* Prepare and maintain Job Descriptions for all positions.
* Source candidates through recruitment portals, consultants, references and other channels.
* Conduct initial HR screening and coordinate technical/departmental interviews.
* Complete background/reference verification wherever applicable.
* Manage offer, appointment, joining and induction processes.
* Maintain recruitment MIS and joining/attrition reports.

**3\. Hospital HR Operations**

* Maintain complete employee personnel files and HR documentation.
* Manage employee lifecycle from joining to exit.
* Ensure proper documentation of appointment letters, confirmations, transfers, promotions and disciplinary actions.
* Maintain employee database and HR records.
* Coordinate employee ID cards, access control and other HR\-related requirements.
* Establish and monitor HR SOPs and workflows.

**4\. Attendance, Leave \& Shift Management**

* Monitor biometric/HRMS attendance.
* Coordinate shift rosters with departmental HODs.
* Monitor late coming, absenteeism, overtime and shift\-related issues.
* Manage leave applications and leave records.
* Ensure proper attendance inputs for payroll processing.

**5\. Payroll \& Compensation**

* Coordinate monthly payroll processing with Accounts/Finance.
* Verify attendance, leave, overtime, incentives and deductions.
* Ensure proper salary structure and statutory deductions.
* Handle employee salary\-related queries.
* Maintain payroll MIS and employee cost reports.
* Coordinate full \& final settlement of exiting employees.

**6\. Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour and employment laws.
* Coordinate statutory requirements relating to **EPF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Bonus, Gratuity, Minimum Wages and other applicable legislation**.
* Maintain statutory registers, records and documentation.
* Coordinate labour inspections, audits and statutory notices.
* Ensure timely submission of applicable statutory returns.
* Coordinate with external consultants wherever required.

**7\. Employee Relations**

* Handle employee grievances and workplace issues professionally.
* Develop positive employee\-management relations.
* Conduct disciplinary proceedings in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Maintain proper documentation of warnings, notices and disciplinary actions.
* Support management in resolving employee\-related matters.

**8\. Performance Management**

* Develop and implement KPI/KRA\-based performance evaluation systems.
* Coordinate probation reviews, annual appraisals and performance reviews.
* Work with HODs to establish measurable KRAs and KPIs.
* Track employee performance and improvement plans.
* Prepare performance review MIS for management.

**9\. Training \& Development**

* Identify training requirements department\-wise.
* Prepare annual training calendars.
* Coordinate induction and orientation programs.
* Organize training on HR policies, workplace conduct, communication and other relevant areas.
* Coordinate mandatory/role\-specific training with concerned hospital departments.

**10\. Employee Engagement \& Welfare**

* Develop employee engagement initiatives.
* Coordinate employee welfare activities and events.
* Conduct employee feedback and engagement surveys.
* Support employee recognition and appreciation programs.
* Monitor workplace discipline, culture and employee satisfaction.

**11\. HR Policies \& SOPs**

* Develop, update and implement HR policies.
* Maintain HR SOPs, forms, registers and formats.
* Standardize HR documentation across departments.
* Review existing HR processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Establish proper document control and HR records management.

**12\. Hospital\-Specific HR Coordination**

* Coordinate manpower requirements with **Nursing, ICU, OT, Emergency, Laboratory, Radiology, Pharmacy, Front Office, Housekeeping, Security and other departments**.
* Support recruitment and credential/document verification processes for healthcare professionals as applicable.
* Monitor staffing requirements for 24×7 hospital operations.
* Coordinate HR requirements related to shifts, emergency coverage and manpower availability.
* Support management during hospital audits and accreditation\-related HR documentation.

**Key KRAs**

**KRA**

**Key Responsibility**

Manpower Planning

Maintain optimum staffing levels

Recruitment

Timely closure of approved vacancies

Employee Documentation

100% employee records and documentation

Attendance \& Leave

Accurate and timely attendance management

Payroll

Accurate monthly payroll inputs

Compliance

Timely statutory compliance and records

Performance Management

Effective KRA/KPI review process

Employee Relations

Timely grievance resolution

Training

Department\-wise training implementation

HR Policies

Attrition

Monitor and analyse employee turnover

HR MIS

Accurate and timely management reports

**Suggested HR MIS / Reports**

The HR Manager should regularly maintain and submit:

* Employee Master Data
* Department\-wise Manpower Report
* Recruitment Tracker
* Vacancy Status Report
* Joining \& Exit Report
* Attrition Report
* Attendance \& Absenteeism Report
* Leave Report
* Overtime Report
* Payroll Summary
* Statutory Compliance Tracker
* Training Calendar \& Training MIS
* Performance Review Tracker
* Employee Grievance Register
* Disciplinary Action Register
* Contract/Third\-Party Manpower Register
* HR Dashboard for Management

**Authority \& Decision\-Making**

The HR Manager will have authority to:

* Recommend recruitment against approved manpower requirements.
* Conduct initial candidate screening.
* Recommend salary within approved organizational salary structures.
* Recommend confirmation, promotion, transfer and disciplinary actions.
* Approve routine HR processes within delegated authority.
* Escalate critical employee relations and compliance matters to management.
* Recommend improvements to HR policies, systems and manpower structure.

**Note:** Financial approvals, final recruitment approvals, salary exceptions and major disciplinary actions shall remain subject to management's delegated authority matrix.

**Qualification**

* MBA / PGDM / MSW / MA in Human Resources / Personnel Management or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* Knowledge of labour laws and statutory HR compliance is essential.

**Experience**

* **6–10 years of relevant HR experience**, preferably in a hospital, healthcare, multispeciality hospital, healthcare group or other 24×7 organization.
* Experience managing a complete HR function will be preferred.
* Experience handling **doctors, nurses, paramedical, technical and support staff** will be an advantage.
* Strong exposure to payroll, statutory compliance, recruitment and employee relations.

**Required Skills**

* Strong HR Operations knowledge
* Recruitment \& manpower planning
* Labour law \& statutory compliance
* Payroll \& attendance management
* Employee relations
* Performance management
* HR policy development
* HRMS/HR software knowledge
* MS Excel and MIS reporting
* Communication and interpersonal skills
* Conflict resolution
* Leadership and team management
* Confidentiality and professional ethics
* Ability to work in a 24×7 healthcare environment

**Preferred Competencies**

**Professional Competencies**

* Healthcare HR knowledge
* Labour compliance
* HR analytics/MIS
* Process development
* Documentation \& audit readiness

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Leadership
* Ownership
* Problem solving
* Confidentiality
* Team collaboration
* Decision making
* Professional communication
* Employee\-focused approach

**Performance Indicators**

The HR Manager's performance may be assessed through:

* Vacancy closure time
* Manpower availability
* Employee attrition rate
* Attendance/absenteeism
* Payroll accuracy
* Statutory compliance status
* Employee grievance resolution time
* Training completion
* Performance review completion
* HR documentation accuracy
* Employee engagement
* HR process improvement

**Candidate Profile:** A proactive HR professional capable of independently managing **end\-to\-end HR operations in a hospital environment**, with strong knowledge of compliance, recruitment, employee relations, payroll coordination and HR systems.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

title: SNRASSOC, Generalist, HR Relationship Management (BI0008)
description:

* Partner with HR Operations teams to ensure data accuracy and process adherence.
* Support audit requirements and HR governance reviews.

**Policy \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to labour laws, employment regulations, and organizational policies.
* Manage employee documentation and statutory compliance requirements.

**Employee Experience \& Culture**

* Champion DBS's culture, values, and employee value proposition.

* Leverage data to identify risks and recommend actions to business leaders.

* Employee Relations
* Performance Management
* Talent Management \& Succession Planning
* Compensation \& Benefits Administration
* Learning \& Development

* High ownership and accountability

title: Business Communications Specialist
description:
**Role Overview:** We are seeking a proactive and customer\-focused Business Communications Specialist to manage relationship building, key account communications, and service upselling for EVINDIA. In this role, you will serve as the primary bridge between EVINDIA and our existing clients, ensuring consistent official communication, timely sharing of updates and mandatory mailers, and identifying growth opportunities to upsell our expanding portfolio of digital and media services.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

**1\. Client Relationship Management**

* Build, nurture, and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with existing clients and business partners.
* Serve as the main point of contact for day\-to\-day queries, feedback, and operational communications.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention through proactive engagement and prompt follow\-ups.

**2\. Mandatory Communications \& Reporting**

* Draft and dispatch scheduled, mandatory emails, compliance notifications, progress reports, and official updates to clients on a regular basis.
* Maintain organized mailing schedules and client directories to guarantee timely delivery of key documentation.

* Pitch new packages and revenue\-generating features to existing accounts to increase account value.

* Address customer concerns or technical queries efficiently by escalating them to internal teams when required.
* Gather client feedback to suggest platform improvements and service enhancements.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Business Communications, Client Servicing, Account Management, or Customer Success.

* Relationship Building: Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with corporate clients and maintain long\-term partnerships.
* Sales / Upselling: Strong interpersonal persuasion skills with a natural ability to identify customer needs and pitch additional services.
* Organization: Highly organized with keen attention to detail for managing regular email dispatches and client records.
* Industry Interest: Interest in the Electric Vehicle (EV) sector, automotive tech, or digital media platforms is a strong plus.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to grow with India’s leading Electric Vehicle digital platform.
* Dynamic, learning\-focused, and fast\-paced environment.
* Competitive compensation package based on experience and performance.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

title: Senior Executive, IT User Support
description:
**Description:**

The role is responsible for ensuring effective day\-to\-day technical support to employees across a range of hardware and software systems. The role focuses on independently diagnosing complex user issues, performing advanced troubleshooting and fault rectification, and ensuring timely and high\-quality resolution of user problems, queries, and complaints. The role manages end\-to\-end incident resolution, supports root cause identification, and ensures proper escalation and coordination with internal or external support teams when required. The role emphasizes service reliability, adherence to SLAs, user satisfaction, and compliance with IT policies and information security standards.  



  

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide advanced user support for hardware and software issues
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems independently
* Perform detailed troubleshooting and fault rectification
* Coordinate and manage escalations with internal/external teams
* Ensure timely closure of incidents as per SLAs
* Document issues, resolutions, and root causes
* Support system access, configurations, and device setups
* Ensure compliance with IT policies and security standards
* Guide junior support staff when required

### **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES –**

* **Plant IT Leadership \& Service Delivery:** Lead end\-to\-end IT operations and service delivery for the plant, covering Quality Informatics, Manufacturing Informatics, IT Infrastructure, End User Computing, and Information Security.
* **Quality \& Manufacturing Informatics:** Provide techno\-functional leadership and support for QC laboratory and manufacturing computerized systems, including **LIMS, Empower, and equipment control systems** , ensuring availability, compliance, qualification, and effective lifecycle management.
* **Plant IT Infrastructure:** Own and manage plant\-level **LAN/WAN, servers, network, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, server rooms, storage, backup, and end\-user computing infrastructure** to ensure reliable and uninterrupted business operations.
* **Information Security:** Ensure implementation and monitoring of endpoint security, OS\-level access controls, logical access, patch management, vulnerability remediation, local firewall controls, and other applicable information security requirements.
* **Regulatory Compliance \& Audits:** Act as the **Plant IT SPOC** for regulatory and customer audits and ensure compliance with **GxP, SOX, Data Privacy, ISMS, and other applicable regulatory requirements** .
* **IT Governance \& SOP Management:** Establish, implement, and maintain Plant IT **SOPs, procedures, standards, controls, and governance frameworks** in coordination with Quality and relevant business functions.
* **IT Projects \& Digitization:** Lead plant\-level IT projects, infrastructure upgrades, digital transformation, automation, productivity improvement, cost optimization, and technology initiatives in alignment with business requirements.
* **Vendor \& Partner Management:** Manage IT vendors and service partners, including performance monitoring, SLA/OLA compliance, escalation management, technical evaluation, and contract/service governance.
* **Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery:** Ensure effective implementation, monitoring, and periodic testing of **backup, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity** solutions for critical plant IT systems.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and develop the Plant IT team, allocate resources effectively, drive accountability, and ensure timely resolution of IT incidents, service requests, and business requirements.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Work closely with **Plant Leadership, Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, EHS, HR, Finance, Corporate IT, Cybersecurity, and other functions** to understand requirements and deliver effective IT solutions.
* **IT Service Performance:** Monitor Plant IT performance through **SLA/OLA, incident management, problem management, service availability, MTTR, and user satisfaction** , ensuring continuous improvement of IT services.
* **Technology \& Infrastructure Planning:** Work closely with the Head – IT Infrastructure \& Information Security on **IT strategy, capacity planning, technology roadmap, budgeting, CAPEX/OPEX planning, and infrastructure standardization** across the plant.
* **CSV / Computerized System Compliance:** Provide support for **computerized system validation lifecycle activities** , including assessment, qualification, change management, periodic review, and retirement of GxP\-relevant computerized systems.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities for **process improvement, automation, standardization, cost optimization, and technology modernization** to improve plant productivity, quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.

  
**Education:*** Bachelors Degree (BA/BS) B.Tech \- Required
* Master Degree (MS/MA) M.Tech \- Preferred

**Experience:*** 5 years or more in 5 \- 8 Years

**Specialized Knowledge:** **Licenses:**
